findings: SWR-013 in workproducts/SWE.1/software_requirements.md requires a 'safe state', but safety/software_safety_requirements.md states safety assurance is not assessed and .forge-run/manifest.json#scope-target-budgets shows safety_allocation NOT_ASSESSED with safe_state placeholders, so the required safe startup state is undefined and the requirement is not objectively verifiable.
SWR-005 in workproducts/SWE.1/software_requirements.md is not atomic because one requirement combines writing CRC_CR.REV_OUT, writing CRC_CR.RTYPE_OUT, and preserving all other CRC_CR bits.

workproducts/SWE.1/software_requirements.md Open points contradict the requirement set for input reversal: one bullet says the task specifies only CRC_CR.RTYPE_IN, another says the task is restricted to CRC_CR.REV_IN and defers writing CRC_CR.RTYPE_IN, while SWR-006 and SWR-009 specify those writes and register_effects.json includes both field writes.

SWR-006 in workproducts/SWE.1/software_requirements.md is inconsistent with the stated scope because its trigger is 'When the LL function sets the input reversal mode' although it obliges only CRC_CR.RTYPE_IN, while .forge-run/manifest.json#scope-target-budgets defines input reversal mode as CRC_CR.REV_IN with CRC_CR.RTYPE_IN.
